_doc: Who is played by a private man (#933, #1282): a MetaHuman the Character Studio made, fetched into the git-ignored assets/people/private/ by tools/characters/fetch_private.sh (never committed, #692; the bundle's clothes on him are paid and private too, #1176). Read by PeopleBodies.cast_of/cast_model/cast_dress, asked by every HumanBody as he's made (HumanBody._ready): his own entry in `people` (an id: config/valley_folk.json's, a mission's), else with `everyone` one of `looks`, picked by his id, unless his model is kept (`keep_models`, the start of its name: the women) or he is (`keep_people`). He gets `build`'s level (`level`, else `near`: lod1, the review's 4-25 m level; `far`: lod3, past 60 m) when it's laid in, else keeps his own model: nothing changes in a build without the private files. A look re-dresses him so the same face doesn't read as clones: `hat` (a tint on his own hat; [0,0,0,0] for none, his hair shows), `vest`, `shirt`, `trousers`, `skin` (tints on his own shapes' textures, `skin` his head too), `off` (shapes he goes without: beard, mustache). Costs: docs/reviews/2026-11-metahumans-town.md.
_on: On for debug and local builds (#1282, Sean 2026-11-26: the whole cast on him, for testing the slice). `release` false: a release export keeps everyone's own model until the release encryption is built (#1176's §21A.3; its own issue). The Studio's private build for Sean sets it true (its .github/workflows/private_build.yml).
